flags.description: Investigative NGO Earthsight documented an IKEA supplier's involvement in illegally logging roughly 4 million trees over a decade in protected, climate-critical forests in Siberia, despite FSC audits failing to flag it.

IKEA acknowledged that political prisoners in communist East Germany were used as forced labor to produce components for its furniture in the 1970s-80s, and pledged €6 million in 2024 to a fund compensating survivors.

IKEA owns and operates wind farms and solar parks globally; by 2022 the combined renewable energy generation capacity of Inter IKEA and Ingka Group exceeded IKEA's total global energy consumption, making the group a net energy exporter.
